text:
maria: Heads up — scheduling base-image rebuild this Saturday 02:00 UTC to pull glibc patch and rotate cosign signer key.
ajay: do we have a playbook for rotating the cosign key with KMS? worried about image verification failures.
sara: +1, also need RBAC changes for the new signer service account. who's owning the role update?
maria: @tim and @devon pairing on signer rotation. plan: create new KMS key version, update cosign keyref to use new version, update image-signing pipeline to sign with new key, then canary verify.
tim: proposed RBAC change: add iam.roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on signer-sa for key access; we should scope to project and add condition for 'purpose: image-sign'.
devon: patch to rolebinding ready: ```kubectl patch rolebinding image-signer-binding -n infra --patch '{"subjects":[{"kind":"ServiceAccount","name":"signer-sa","namespace":"infra"}]}'``` but we should use terraform for prod.
sec-bot: SECURITY_ALERT: CVE-2026-0421 affects glibc < 2.35 — rebuild required for runtime images. Marking this thread as P2.
oncall: If something breaks, oncall fallback is to pin to digest of previous signed image and route canaries back to previous pool.
ajay: audit logging question: will we get KMS key-change events in our audit logs? need query example for detecting signer usage.
sara: yes. BigQuery example to find key access: `SELECT timestamp, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail FROM `redwood-audit.cloud_logging` WHERE protoPayload.methodName="cloudkms.cryptoSign" AND resource.type="kms_crypto_key_version" AND timestamp >= "2026-02-01"`
maria: also add cosign verification step to deploy pipeline to fail fast: `cosign verify --key k8s://projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/...@1 image:sha256:...`
tim: canary plan: 10% traffic for 2 hours, health checks + signature verification, rollback if >1% signature mismatch or errors spike.
devon: scheduling: I'll open PR in infra repo with TF change + rollout script. tagging @sara for audit log knobs and @oncall for rollback steps.
maria: thanks. I'll publish a short runbook and test in staging tomorrow, then cut a canary Saturday. :thumbsup:
